All 10 tests pass.

Added a `remind` command (`node src/cli.js remind`) that lists habits not yet marked done today, with a friendly "All habits done for today!" message when nothing's pending, matching the existing `add`/`done`/`list` style. Wired into `cli.js`, tested in `commands.test.js`, and documented in the README.

This only covers on-demand reminders (you run the command and it tells you what's outstanding). Actual push-style reminders would need a delivery mechanism — a few options if you want that next:
1. Add a `--exit-code` style flag so `remind` exits non-zero when something's pending, so you can wire it into a cron job + `mail`/`notify-send`/`terminal-notifier` yourself without adding deps.
2. Print a note in the README showing how to schedule it via cron/launchd calling `remind`.
3. Build actual OS notifications (e.g. `osascript`/`notify-send`) — this needs an external dependency or platform-specific shell-outs, which the "no new deps" rule says I should check with you on first.

My pick: option 1 (exit code) — it's small, dependency-free, and lets you hook it into whatever notification tool you already use.
